context: Tests whether the agent writes Spring Boot 4 property-based tests using @ParameterizedTest + @MethodSource with a seeded SplittableRandom (not jqwik), includes boundary values and as(...) on assertions, and writes secured-route tests that sign in through the app's own JwtAuthenticationConverter role-mapping code using a Personas helper rather than raw jwt().authorities(). Also checks that a report is produced listing behavior covered, how tests were shown to fail, and contract clauses left untested.

checklist.name: @ParameterizedTest usage
checklist.description: OrderServicePropertyTest.java uses @ParameterizedTest on the discount test methods (not plain @Test)

checklist.name: @MethodSource usage
checklist.description: OrderServicePropertyTest.java uses @MethodSource to supply test arguments (not @ValueSource or @CsvSource alone)

checklist.name: SplittableRandom usage
checklist.description: The @MethodSource generator in OrderServicePropertyTest.java uses SplittableRandom with a fixed seed to generate inputs

checklist.name: No jqwik import
checklist.description: Neither test file imports any class from the net.jqwik package

checklist.name: Boundary values in generator
checklist.description: The generator in OrderServicePropertyTest.java explicitly includes boundary values (e.g. quantity 0 or 1, 9/10, 49/50, 99/100, or Integer.MAX_VALUE) rather than purely random values

checklist.name: as(...) on assertions
checklist.description: Assertions in OrderServicePropertyTest.java use .as(...) with the input values included in the message (e.g. assertThat(...).as("quantity=%d", quantity)...)

checklist.name: Personas helper present
checklist.description: A Personas or similar helper class is present (Personas.java or inline in OrderRouteAccessTest.java) that wraps the app's JwtAuthenticationConverter or issues JWT tokens whose claims flow through the app's role-mapping code

checklist.name: Personas used in route test
checklist.description: OrderRouteAccessTest.java uses the Personas helper (e.g. personas.as("admin") or Personas.admin()) rather than raw .with(jwt().authorities(...)) to sign into secured route tests

checklist.name: Route access coverage
checklist.description: OrderRouteAccessTest.java tests both GET /orders and POST /orders with at least: an authenticated user role, an authenticated admin role, and an unauthenticated request

checklist.name: Contract-driven test cases
checklist.description: The property tests cover each discount tier the Javadoc states (20% for quantity >= 100, 15% for >= 50, 10% for >= 10, 0% for quantity == 1) rather than only a single happy-path value

checklist.name: Illegal argument tested
checklist.description: At least one test asserts that calculateDiscount throws IllegalArgumentException for quantity <= 0, as specified in the Javadoc

checklist.name: Report: tests listed
checklist.description: test-report.md lists the tests added with their behavior and testing level (unit / property / integration)

checklist.name: Report: how each test fails
checklist.description: test-report.md names, for each test, the line of OrderService or SecurityConfig to break to make it fail, and says whether that failure was observed by running the test or not run; it does not claim test output it did not see

checklist.name: Report: contract gap
checklist.description: test-report.md points out that the Javadoc states no discount for quantities 2 to 9 (only quantity == 1 is 0%), or lists another clause left untested such as the unitPrice rule or the cap at price * quantity
